screening_decisions.reason: This is a mathematical modeling study estimating required sensitivity of POC tests, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study. No prospective patient enrollment or 2x2 data.
Study focuses on concordance between Medicare claims and SEER for bone metastases in prostate cancer. Not related to Chlamydia trachomatis or point-of-care testing.

Prospective trial that compares multiple rapid POC tests (DFA, OIA) against reference standards (culture and PCR) in 1384 women. Likely provides diagnostic accuracy data and 2x2 tables. Meets population (nonpregnant women of reproductive age) and design criteria.

Pilot diagnostic accuracy study evaluating QuickVue rapid chlamydia test against PCR in high and low prevalence populations. Provides sensitivity, specificity, and PPV. Likely prospective enrollment; include per conservative approach.
Clinical practice guideline for syndromic management of STIs, not an original diagnostic accuracy study.
Commentary/narrative review discussing the way forward for STI rapid tests, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.

Prospective field evaluation of two chlamydia POC tests (CRT and ACON) against NAAT in 226 men and 225 women. Provides sensitivity and specificity. Meets population (nonpregnant women and men of reproductive age) and design criteria.

Prospective clinic-based evaluation of Clearview Chlamydia MF rapid test against Roche Amplicor in 1497 women at high risk. Provides sensitivity, specificity, and PPV. Meets population and design criteria.

Prospective cohort study evaluating a new rapid urine test for chlamydia (Chlamydia Rapid Test) against PCR in 1211 men. Provides diagnostic accuracy measures. Meets population (men of reproductive age) and design criteria.
CDC recommendations for laboratory-based detection; not an original diagnostic accuracy study.
Systematic review of point-of-care tests for STIs; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Summary of evidence for CDC treatment guidelines; not an original diagnostic accuracy study.
Cost-effectiveness analysis using decision tree modeling with a hypothetical cohort; not a prospective study enrolling real patients and generating diagnostic accuracy data.

Prospective evaluation of a CE-marked rapid home chlamydia test (HandiLab-C) against two NAATs in 231 women. Provides sensitivity and specificity. Qualifies as a point-of-care test evaluation in nonpregnant women of reproductive age.
Study on macrolide treatment for Haemophilus ducreyi (chancroid); not related to Chlamydia trachomatis diagnostic accuracy.
Description of QUADAS-2 quality assessment tool; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Methodology paper on bivariate meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy studies; not an original study evaluating a POC test.
Systematic review summarizing performance of rapid CT tests; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Mathematical modeling study on partner notification for Chlamydia; not a diagnostic test accuracy study.
Prospective diagnostic accuracy study evaluating Clearview and CRT rapid tests against PCR in Filipino women. Provides sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV. Meets population and design criteria.
Simulation study assessing performance of publication bias tests in meta-analyses; not an original diagnostic accuracy study.
Interpretation of findings from RCTs on chlamydia screening to prevent PID; not a diagnostic test accuracy study.
Cohort study identifying risk factors for C. trachomatis PID; does not evaluate a point-of-care test.
Systematic review on individual characteristics influencing nurses' research utilization, completely unrelated to Chlamydia trachomatis or POC testing.
Narrative review of laboratory diagnostic methods for C. trachomatis; not an original prospective study evaluating a rapid point-of-care test.
Systematic review, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Systematic review about NAATs (reference standard), not evaluating a rapid point-of-care test for Chlamydia.

Reference standard for true infection is a composite of four assays, not nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) alone as required by the review protocol. Does not meet the reference standard criterion.
National population-based prevalence survey; not a diagnostic accuracy study of a rapid point-of-care test.

Diagnostic accuracy study of rapid point-of-care tests for Chlamydia trachomatis (among others) in symptomatic nonpregnant women of reproductive age, using nucleic acid amplification methods as the reference standard. Reports 2x2 data.

Reference standard for true positives was defined as positivity on ≥3 of multiple assays (not solely NAAT), and used discrepant analysis. This does not meet the protocol requirement of NAAT as the reference standard.
Evaluates the rapid BioStar optical immunoassay (POC test) against two NAATs as reference standard in adolescent women; reports sensitivity and specificity.
Evaluates the Chlamydia Rapid Test Device (POC) against PCR (NAAT) in asymptomatic men; pilot diagnostic accuracy study with 2x2 data.
Prevalence study using PCR to detect Chlamydia; does not evaluate a rapid point-of-care index test.
Overview/review of laboratory diagnostic methods; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Sentinel surveillance study of HIV/STI prevalence and risk behaviors; not a diagnostic accuracy study of a rapid POC test.
Cross-sectional prevalence and aetiology study; not evaluating a rapid point-of-care test's accuracy.
Clinic-based evaluation of a rapid POC test compared to PCR (NAAT) in female sex workers; reports sensitivity and specificity. Meets diagnostic accuracy study criteria.
Narrative review of diagnostic tests; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Performance evaluation study of a new Chlamydia Rapid Test (POC) against PCR and SDA (NAATs) in women; prospective design, reports 2x2 data.
Study of Chlamydia serovars and clinical manifestations; not a diagnostic accuracy study.
Performance evaluation of a point-of-care test (CRT) against NAAT (Aptima) in women; reports sensitivity, specificity, and bacterial load.
Review article on immune modulation mechanisms of Chlamydia; not a diagnostic accuracy study.
Article on search strategies for identifying diagnostic accuracy studies; not an original diagnostic accuracy study.
Evaluation of a rapid optical immunoassay (POC) compared to ligase chain reaction (NAAT) in outpatient women; diagnostic accuracy study with reported sensitivity/specificity.
Diagnostic accuracy study comparing three rapid point-of-care tests against NAAT in women attending an STI clinic; prospective enrollment, 2x2 data.
Review of risk factors for genital chlamydial infection; not a diagnostic accuracy study.
Guidelines for laboratory diagnosis; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Prototype development and feasibility study using small numbers, not a formal diagnostic accuracy study with consecutive/random sampling. Does not meet the prospective study design criterion.
Study on treatment follow-up after screening; does not evaluate diagnostic accuracy of a test.
